newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO denies Bulgarian bank report.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO denies Bulgarian bank report.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Monday it had no plans to seek a contract to manage Biochim Bank, the Bulgarian state bank to which it is providing consultancy services.
Bulgarian newspaper Pari on Monday quoted Biochim Bank as saying it expected to seal a management contract with ABN AMRO by mid-July.

ABN AMRO spokesman Jules Prast said the Dutch bank's international consultancy group had a "twinning" relationship with the Bulgarian bank, under which the two banks co-operate but ABN AMRO has no management responsibility.
ABN AMRO has a similar relationship with banks in Russia, Lithuania and China.
Prast said it was possible to conclude a management contract with the banks, allowing ABN AMRO to install its own management.
But he said ABN AMRO was happy with the existing relationship with Biochim.
"There will not be a management contract as far as we are concerned," he said, adding it was for the Bulgarian bank to speak on its own behalf.
